Terminal & Shell

Terminal & Shell apps for Omarchy

6 packages from the official Omarchy repository.

Reviewed 2026-10-19 · independent editorial guide

Short answer

Install any of these with omarchy pkg add <name>. The list below has all 6 terminal & shell packages in the official repo as of 2026-10-19.

Every terminal & shell package

Listed alphabetically. Categories are this site's own grouping; the packages and versions come from pkgs.omarchy.org.

  • caja-open-any-terminal omarchy pkg add caja-open-any-terminal
    Adds an "Open Terminal Here" option for your favorite terminal to the Caja file manager.
  • nautilus-open-any-terminal omarchy pkg add nautilus-open-any-terminal
    Right-click any folder and pop open the terminal you actually use.
  • omarchy-fish omarchy pkg add omarchy-fish
    A pre-built Fish shell setup with fuzzy search, git shortcuts, and Omarchy-friendly keybindings.
  • omarchy-zsh omarchy pkg add omarchy-zsh
    Turns Omarchy's shared shell config into a ready-to-use Zsh setup.
  • python-terminaltexteffects omarchy pkg add python-terminaltexteffects
    A visual effects engine that animates terminal text output — think Matrix rain, but for any string.
  • ttfx omarchy pkg add ttfx
    Pipe any text through your terminal and watch it decrypt, burn, or rain down like The Matrix.
